purpose: Define the concrete repository targets and row schema required before an atomic predictive-v1 correction operator can be considered runnable.

target_module.claim_boundary: The module may emit diagnostics only until an accepted delta_uet_or_ci operator, uncertainty policy, and independent validation source exist.

required_local_artifacts.purpose: Freeze operator parameters before holdout evaluation.
Store source-row residuals emitted by the target module.
Declare model/source uncertainty handling before threshold reclassification.

acceptance_checks.requirement: Target module exists and exposes the required entrypoint.
Parameter manifest exists and is hashed in the primary verifier artifact.
Residual rows exist and include every required schema field.
Every residual row has parameters_locked_before_evaluation=true and used_for_parameter_fit=false for holdout/external rows.
Uncertainty policy exists before validation-ready thresholds are allowed.

operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.requirement: Target module and entrypoint are present.
Diagnostic residual rows satisfy the required row schema and no-leakage flags.
A fixed CI/correlated or explicit UET correction operator emits the residual rows.
operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.required_artifact: accepted delta_uet_or_ci operator implementation and residual artifact

operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.requirement: Operator parameters are locked independently of holdout and CHIANTI rows.
operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.evidence_source: operator parameter manifest plus accepted implementation provenance
operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.required_artifact: operator parameter manifest with implementation provenance and lock timestamp

operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.requirement: Operator uncertainty is computable or explicitly noncomputable for every residual row.
operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.evidence_source: operator uncertainty policy consumed by residual rows
operator_acceptance_decision_matrix.required_artifact: operator residual rows with model_uncertainty_eV sourced from the accepted operator

forbidden_acceptance_states: target module exists but only wraps the current quantum-defect fit
holdout or CHIANTI rows are used to set operator parameters
accepted operator count is raised before residual rows exist
claim_boundary: This manifest defines the acceptance harness for a future runnable operator. It does not create or validate an operator.
